experiments.scope: 32 groups of 32 consecutive final message words. A 20-bit digest mask makes the scaled pair count match a 2^128 search of a 256-bit digest.
experiments.hypothesis: Masked collisions of this grouped 2-round BLAKE3 family occur at the independent-uniform birthday rate.

experiments.scope: One group and 1024 consecutive final message words, the most dependent layout, under the same 20-bit mask.
experiments.hypothesis: A single varying message word still produces masked collisions at the independent-uniform birthday rate.
